subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Luna is the nickname of a meteorite specimen housed at the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History.
• The Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History is located in Washington, D.C.
• Luna is classified as a carbonaceous chondrite.
• Phoenix is the nickname of a meteorite specimen housed at the American Museum of Natural History.
• The American Museum of Natural History is located in New York City.
• Phoenix is classified as a carbonaceous chondrite.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two specimens. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, where Luna is housed, is located in Washington, D.C.
choices.B: Phoenix is the nickname of a carbonaceous chondrite specimen housed at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City.
choices.C: While Luna is housed at the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, Phoenix is housed at the American Museum of Natural History.
choices.D: The meteorite specimens Luna and Phoenix are both classified as carbonaceous chondrites.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity between the two specimens, noting that Luna and Phoenix are both classified as the same type: carbonaceous chondrites.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence contrasts the locations of Luna and Phoenix; it doesn't emphasize a similarity between the two specimens.
